execution_environment.dependencies: stdlib only (json, math, hashlib, collections, random, pathlib)

input_artifacts.description: Source measurement data: 7 tasks on 1 Magento site, 3 definitions, locatable_sample capped at 20 elements per task

output_artifacts.description: Producer result packet with all mandatory fields
Analysis script implementing density ratio computation and statistical tests
Complete analysis output: density matrix, metrics, controls, decision rule evaluation

frozen_inputs_immutability: All frozen files (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md, freeze.json) were read but never modified during execution. The experiment was executed exactly as specified in the frozen design.

density_formula.canonical: (matching_count * 0.5) / elements_with_bbox — expected density under p=0.5 independent Bernoulli inclusion per element
density_formula.weighted: sum(element_area / total_area for matching elements) — area-weighted density

definitions.DEF_FULL_MAP: Elements whose canonical role (after role_map: a→link, input→textbox) is in the interactive set {button, link, textbox, checkbox, radio, combobox, listbox, menuitem, tab, slider, spinbutton, searchbox, switch}

measurement_methodology.tasks: 7 unique tasks from Magento shopping site (3 product_listing, 3 detail, 1 cart), deduplicated from 10 measurements (excluding checkout and duplicate cart_1)
measurement_methodology.sample_scope: truncated-first-20 locatable_sample (20 elements per task, actual locatable_elements 21-82)

reproducibility.seed: No random seed required for canonical density (expected value is deterministic). NC1 shuffle uses seed=42.
